plan_item: 77.44.7.D / D-06 — Bound Rich Text HTML clipboard traversal

change.summary: After DOMParser, a bounded iterative check now rejects clipboard trees with more than 20000 DOM nodes or more than 64 levels before the existing recursive rich-text conversion runs. The content-size and aggregate output budgets remain unchanged. Tests cover over-depth and over-wide payloads, accepted safely deep formatted input at the configured boundary, user-facing rejection without editor-content replacement, and preservation of separate Save and Publish behavior. The Editor entry/module cache-bust token was advanced.
